sources.entry: Element - Fully-featured Matrix client for Web, iOS & Android. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Nodejs
Element | A glossy Matrix collaboration client

summary.one_liner: Element Web is a Matrix web and desktop client built on the Matrix JS SDK, also packaged as an Electron desktop app.
summary.what_it_does: Element (formerly Vector and Riot) is a Matrix chat client for the web, usable through a hosted instance or self-hosted. The README describes it as a web and desktop client built with the Matrix JS SDK. It can be run as a desktop app wrapped in Electron, with pre-built downloads or a build-from-source path. The repository is a monorepo that hosts Element Web and other related projects in subdirectories. The README also defines tiers of browser and OS support and recommends the separate native apps element-x-android and element-x-ios for mobile devices. Translation, developer guides, and issue triage processes are documented in the repo.
use_cases: Chat on the Matrix network from a web browser
Run a self-hosted Matrix web client
Use Matrix chat as a desktop application
Contribute translations to a chat client
Host a private team chat front end for Matrix
how_to_run: Use the hosted copy of Element at the official site (develop branch is continuously deployed)
To host your own instance, follow the Installing Element Web documentation
To install the desktop app, download a pre-built version or follow the build instructions in the docs
Read the developer guide, code style, and contribution guide before developing
notable: Built on the Matrix JS SDK, serving as a client for the Matrix protocol
Available as both a web app and an Electron-wrapped desktop app
Monorepo structure with Element Web and related projects in subdirectories
Multi-licensed: AGPL v3, GPL v3, or paid commercial license
caveats: Support is tiered: only the latest desktop browsers and Element Desktop are fully supported; other browsers get best-effort or community support
The README recommends native apps for Android and iOS rather than the web client on mobile
Commercial use without AGPL/GPL terms requires a paid Element Commercial License
summary.license: AGPL-3.0 OR GPL-3.0 OR Element Commercial License (multi-licensed; Apache-2.0 per listing metadata)
